about: Scan matching, case by case (coa_core::scan; first computed by the server's ocr.find_ids / ocr.closest, which it replaces). find_ids: an id in `guids` that looks like PKPR-<5 to 8 lower-case hex digits> (any case of PKPR-) is found in a line of `texts` (each line on its own, look-alike letters o q i l s z g t read as 0 0 1 1 5 2 9 7, then everything but 0-9 a-z dropped, the first 80 characters kept, lines under 5 skipped) exactly (dist 0), or, for an 8-digit id, with 1 character wrong, missing or extra anywhere, or 2 on a line starting like 'Lot' or in typed text. Best first, then by id. closest: when no id was found, the packages the rest of the label fits: a weight or psilocybin figure read from its own line must match within 0.011 (3 points each), else 1 point each when the figure appears anywhere; 2 for the best-by date, 1 per strain word (at most 3), 2 for a lot number at most 4 characters off; the weight or psilocybin must be on the label; at least 3 points; 6 at most, best first then by id. Run by coa_core/tests/scan_cases.rs, coa/tests/test_scan_cases.py, mazama_sales/tests/unit/test_ocr.py and mazama_mobile/test/coa_core_ffi_test.dart.
